data.name: Detectives United: Vengeance from the Past Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Elephant Games is gathering an all-star team for the latest gripping case in the Detectives United series!

When an outbreak of mystical activity sweeps the city, Dorian and Anna are forced to face the past at one of the Brown family’s oldest mansions. But the investigation takes a drastic turn for the worse when the two go missing! Ewan’s going to need backup if he’s going to find his friends, and who better to help crack such a difficult case than James Blackthorn?

With monsters on their trail, a mysterious madman seeking vengeance, and a house full of dangerous artifacts, can you play as your four favorite detectives and save the day? There’s only one way to find out. So, grab your best detective gear for the riveting case of a lifetime in this Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Travel through time and pain in the Bonus Game!

  • Obtain collectibles while on Expedition!

  • Replay your favorite HOPs, enjoy the puzzle, and earn achievements!

  • Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, videos, and more!

  • Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game - a sub genre of point & click adventure. Follow protagonists on a story-driven quest, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve various puzzles to advance the plot.
